narration: Hiii, everyone! Welcome to my little magical world! I'm so happy you're here. I have a very special invitation for you, so come and celebrate with me!

It's me, your little princess, Zaelah Hesztia Tembreza Delos Santos! I'm turning ONE, and I'm also celebrating my very special Baptism! Mommy and Daddy are so excited, and I would love to share this wonderful day with you!
So, when is my special day? It's on December second, twenty twenty-six, at three o'clock in the afternoon! We'll be celebrating at Cai's Garden Resort. I hope you'll save the date and come join me!

A little smile, tiny hands, and a whole lot of love! That's me! I'm growing up surrounded by so much love, and I can't wait to make happy memories with all the special people in my life. I hope you'll be there!
This celebration is extra special because I'll be receiving the beautiful gift of Holy Baptism. It's the beginning of my journey with God. Please join me as I receive His love, grace, and blessings!

Mommy and Daddy would be so happy to celebrate this beautiful day with you! Your presence would make my celebration even more special. And here's a little request: please wear semi-formal or casual attire in our lovely pastel colors. I can't wait to see you!

Yaaay! Thank you so much for spending a little time with me! I hope you can come and celebrate my special day. I'm so excited to see you, share smiles, and make wonderful memories together! See you soon! Mwaah! Love, your little princess, Zaelah!
